title: Echo Workshop 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 110 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
The requested budget of INR 18,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Workshop.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
